items.text: Puka Nacua listed IN for Sunday after hip injury; returning from absence since Week 1.
items.why: Hip injury cleared; no designation on final report.
items.implication: Immediate WR1/2 upside return vs Eagles; monitor for snap limits.
items.opportunity: Routes and targets likely high in Rams offense.

items.text: Nico Collins listed IN returning from hamstring.
items.implication: Elite WR1 boost for Texans vs Cowboys.
Jets RB committee or backup lead.

items.text: Eagles ruled out WR DeVonta Smith for Sunday’s game vs Rams due to hamstring.
Vikings WR Justin Jefferson is out Sunday due to sprained ankle.
items.implication: Sits vs Dolphins; major WR1 void.

items.text: Great to have Puka Nacua (hip) back; speculation on possible snap limits, wait and see.
items.why: Returning from hip; eye-test and role strong historically.
items.implication: Start with confidence but caveat volume if limited.
items.opportunity: Primary target share in LAR passing game.

items.text: Excellent spot for Nico Collins (hamstring) return; Cowboys inflate opposing WR scoring by 7.3% (most in NFL); Texans implied 7th-most points.
items.why: DvP data and team total support big game.

items.text: The moment Jordan Addison truthers have been waiting for. Home vs borderline NFL secondary with Justin Jefferson out.
items.why: Jefferson absence opens targets at home vs weak secondary.

items.text: Eagles situation getting worse. Without three most important players vs Rams: DeVonta Smith, Dallas Goedert, Zack Baun.
items.implication: Hurts/PHI offense less efficient; fade supporting pieces.
items.opportunity: Remaining WRs/TE see volume but lower ceiling.

items.text: De'Von Achane listed OUT (with Caleb Douglas).
items.implication: MIA RB void for rest of season.

items.text: Tough runout for Jadarian Price: lost GL/base to Wilson, pass to Holani, fumbles, chest hurt, Charbonnet back practicing. Passes eye test long-term though; far from over.
items.opportunity: Long-term positive eye test if healthy.

items.text: Jaylen Warren LOVE: 90% snaps last week, 20 of 22 RB touches; full workhorse with Rico Dowdle out; CLE allows 88+ rush yards every game.
items.opportunity: High snap share, carries, third-down work.

items.text: Jeremiyah Love LOVE: RB5 utilization, 26 touches last week; Giants allow 5.1 YPC (3rd-most); double-digit target share every game.
Omarion Hampton HATE: RB27 utilization, 3.5% targets, 25% routes; snaps down to 42%, 13% third downs; SEA allows 2.9 YPC (2nd-fewest).
items.opportunity: Limited; conflict with any role expansion hopes.
